domain_sources.canonical_citation: Dietvorst, B. J., Simmons, J. P., & Massey, C. (2015). Algorithm Aversion: People Erroneously Avoid Algorithms After Seeing Them Err. Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 144(1), 114–126.

domain_usage.supports: Algorithm Errorを観察した後にAlgorithmを過少利用する条件。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Logg, J. M., Minson, J. A., & Moore, D. A. (2019). Algorithm Appreciation: People Prefer Algorithmic to Human Judgment. Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, 151, 90–103.

domain_usage.supports: 一定条件でAlgorithmic AdviceがHuman Adviceより強く利用されること。
domain_usage.does_not_support: Algorithmic AdviceへのHigh RelianceがAppropriate Relianceであること。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Tversky, A., & Kahneman, D. (1981). The Framing of Decisions and the Psychology of Choice. Science, 211(4481), 453–458.

domain_usage.supports: Equivalent Decision Problems can yield different choices depending on framing.
domain_usage.does_not_support: Conversational Generative AIに同一Effect Sizeが存在すること。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Sniezek, J. A., & Buckley, T. (1995). Cueing and Cognitive Conflict in Judge-Advisor Decision Making. Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, 62(2), 159–174.

domain_usage.supports: Initial Judgment、Advice、Final Judgmentを分離してAdvice Influenceを研究するJASのPrior Art。
domain_usage.does_not_support: Advice InfluenceがFormal Authority Transferを意味すること。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Bailey, P. E., Leon, T., Ebner, N. C., Moustafa, A. A., & Weidemann, G. (2023). A meta-analysis of the weight of advice in decision-making. Current Psychology, 42, 24516–24541.

domain_usage.supports: Advice WeightがContext、Advisor、Judge等によって変化すること。
domain_usage.does_not_support: 一つのUniversal WOA値をAI Adviceへ適用すること。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Mosier, K. L., Skitka, L. J., Heers, S., & Burdick, M. (1998). Automation Bias: Decision Making and Performance in High-Tech Cockpits. The International Journal of Aviation Psychology, 8(1), 47–63.

domain_usage.supports: Automation BiasにおけるOmission / Commission Errorの存在。
domain_usage.does_not_support: Modern LLMで同じEffect Size・Failure Patternが必ず生じること。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Parasuraman, R., & Manzey, D. H. (2010). Complacency and Bias in Human Use of Automation: An Attentional Integration. Human Factors, 52(3), 381–410.

domain_usage.supports: Automation BiasとAutomation Complacencyを、Attention、Workload等と関連づけて分析するPrior Art。
domain_usage.does_not_support: Automation Biasを単なるTrustとして説明すること。

domain_sources.canonical_citation: Vaccaro, A. G., Almaatouq, A., & Malone, T. W. (2024). When combinations of humans and AI are useful: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Nature Human Behaviour.

domain_usage.supports: Human–AI Combinationが自動的にBest Solo Performerを上回らないこと。Decision TaskとCreation Taskで結果が異なること。

domain_usage.does_not_support:
AI Explanation generally destroys critical thinking.
すべてのExplanationがDecision Qualityを低下させること。
